title: RAG AI Application Architecture
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation grounds an LLM's answer in your own documents. An offline pipeline turns documents into searchable vectors; at question time the system retrieves the most relevant chunks and hands them to the model as context.

walkthrough.title: User asks a question
walkthrough.text: The chat UI POSTs the query with the user's JWT to the gateway, which authenticates, rate-limits, and opens an SSE stream back to the browser.

walkthrough.title: Embed the query
walkthrough.text: The orchestrator condenses follow-up questions using chat history, then sends the query text to the same embeddings model used at ingestion time.

walkthrough.title: Similarity search
walkthrough.text: The query vector, plus an ACL filter derived server-side from the token, is sent to the vector DB, which returns the top-20 nearest chunks.

walkthrough.title: Rerank and assemble
walkthrough.text: A cross-encoder reranks the 20 candidates down to about 5, fits them into the token budget, and builds a prompt with numbered, delimited sources.

walkthrough.title: Generate
walkthrough.text: The LLM is told to answer only from the supplied context, cite sources as [n], and abstain if the context is insufficient.

walkthrough.title: Stream back
walkthrough.text: Tokens stream from the LLM through the gateway to the UI, followed by a final event carrying citations and token usage.

data.label: Source Document Store

output.name: Change event
output.type: JSON: { objectKey, etag, mimeType, op: "put" | "delete", acl: string[] }

responsibilities: System of record for raw source documents and their access-control lists.
Emits create, update, and delete events that trigger re-ingestion.
Versions objects (etag) so unchanged documents are not re-embedded.

failureModes.impact: Index goes stale; users get confident answers from outdated policy docs.
failureModes.mitigation: Freshness SLO on lastSyncedAt per source, with alerting.

failureModes.scenario: Delete or ACL change is not propagated
failureModes.impact: Revoked or deleted content keeps appearing in answers, which is a compliance incident.
failureModes.mitigation: Tombstone events plus delete-by-docId in the vector DB; periodic reconciliation job.

data.label: Document Chunking Processor

output.name: Chunks
output.type: JSON: Chunk[] { chunkId, docId, text, tokenCount, metadata: { title, page, section, acl[] } }

responsibilities: Extracts text from each format, including tables and OCR for scanned pages.
Splits on document structure (headings, paragraphs) into 300 to 800 token chunks with about 15% overlap.
Derives a deterministic chunkId = hash(docId + offset) so upserts are idempotent.

failureModes.scenario: Parser fails on a scanned PDF or complex table
failureModes.impact: Empty or garbled chunks; the document is effectively invisible to search.
failureModes.mitigation: OCR fallback, alert on zero-text docs, route failures to a dead-letter queue.

failureModes.impact: Ingestion queue backs up and all new documents are delayed.
failureModes.mitigation: Max-receive count with DLQ; ingestion lag dashboard.

failureModes.scenario: Answer split across a chunk boundary
failureModes.impact: Neither half scores well; retrieval misses the answer.
failureModes.mitigation: Structure-aware splitting plus overlap; consider parent-document retrieval.

data.label: Embeddings API
responsibilities: Maps text into a shared semantic vector space where similar meaning means nearby vectors.
Serves two workloads: bulk batches (ingestion) and single, latency-sensitive calls (queries).
Model and version must be identical on both paths, or the vectors are not comparable.

failureModes.impact: Ingestion throttling starves live query traffic sharing the same quota.
failureModes.mitigation: Separate API keys or quotas per path; exponential backoff with jitter.

failureModes.impact: Queries cannot be embedded, so retrieval is impossible.
failureModes.mitigation: Degraded mode using BM25 keyword search; circuit breaker.

failureModes.scenario: Model upgraded on only one path
failureModes.impact: Query vectors no longer match stored vectors; relevance collapses with no errors raised.
failureModes.mitigation: Put the model version in the index name; re-embed into a new index, then swap blue/green.

data.label: Vector Database

input.name: Query
input.type: JSON: { vector: float32[1536], topK: 20, filter: { acl: { $in: userGroups } } }

output.name: Matches
output.type: JSON: Match[] { id, score, metadata: { text, docId, title } }

responsibilities: Approximate nearest-neighbour search (e.g. HNSW) over millions of vectors in milliseconds.
Applies metadata filters (tenant, ACL, date) inside the search, not after it.
Optionally runs hybrid dense + sparse (keyword) retrieval for exact terms such as SKUs and error codes.

failureModes.impact: No context. The real risk is the LLM answering anyway, ungrounded.
failureModes.mitigation: Fail closed: return an explicit 'cannot answer right now'; never call the LLM without context silently.

failureModes.impact: Cross-tenant data leak through generated answers.
failureModes.mitigation: Derive the filter server-side from the verified token; add tests that assert the filter is present.

failureModes.impact: Restrictive filters return zero results even though matches exist.
failureModes.mitigation: Use filtered (pre-filter) ANN search supported by the engine.

data.label: Chat Client UI

input.name: Answer stream
input.type: SSE: { delta: string } … { done: true, citations: Citation[] }

output.name: Chat request
output.type: JSON: { query: string, conversationId: string } + Authorization: Bearer <JWT>

responsibilities: Captures the question and conversation ID and sends them with the user's token.
Renders streamed tokens incrementally so first output appears in under a second.
Shows citations linking to source chunks, and collects thumbs-up/down feedback for evaluation.

failureModes.impact: A truncated answer looks complete to the user.
failureModes.mitigation: Treat a missing done event as an error; show 'answer interrupted' with retry.

failureModes.impact: Duplicate LLM calls double the cost.
failureModes.mitigation: Idempotency key per message; disable send while streaming.

data.label: API Gateway & RAG Orchestrator

output.name: To assembler
output.type: JSON: { query, history: Message[], userGroups: string[] }

responsibilities: Authenticates, authorizes, and rate-limits per user and tenant; derives userGroups for ACL filtering.
Runs the pipeline (embed, retrieve, assemble, generate) with per-step timeouts inside a total deadline.
Relays the token stream to the client and emits traces with retrieved IDs and token usage.

failureModes.impact: Slow dependencies pile up open requests until workers are exhausted.
failureModes.mitigation: Deadline budget (e.g. 30s total, 2s retrieve) propagated to every hop.

failureModes.impact: Tokens are paid for but never seen.
failureModes.mitigation: Propagate cancellation (AbortController) to the upstream LLM call.

failureModes.impact: In-flight streams on that instance drop.
failureModes.mitigation: Stateless, horizontally scaled replicas; conversation state lives in a store, not memory.

data.label: Context Assembler & Reranker

output.name: Prompt
output.type: JSON: { system: string, messages: Message[], sources: chunkId[] }

responsibilities: Reranks the top-20 vector hits with a cross-encoder and keeps about 5 that clear a relevance threshold.
Deduplicates and fits chunks into a fixed token budget (e.g. 6k) for the context window.
Wraps retrieved text in delimiters as untrusted data and numbers sources [1]..[n] for citation.

failureModes.impact: Lower answer quality, not an outage.
failureModes.mitigation: Fall back to raw vector-score order; flag the response as degraded in traces.

failureModes.impact: LLM returns 400 context_length_exceeded.
failureModes.mitigation: Count tokens before sending; drop the lowest-ranked chunks first.

failureModes.scenario: Prompt injection inside a retrieved document
failureModes.impact: Document text such as 'ignore previous instructions' hijacks the model.
failureModes.mitigation: Delimit sources, state in the system prompt that they are data, filter outputs.

failureModes.impact: The model hallucinates to fill the gap.
failureModes.mitigation: Short-circuit with 'no relevant information found' instead of calling the LLM.

data.label: LLM Inference Engine

input.name: Generation request
input.type: JSON: { model, system, messages[], max_tokens, stream: true }

output.name: Completion stream
output.type: SSE: text deltas … { stop_reason, usage: { input_tokens, output_tokens } }

responsibilities: Generates an answer grounded only in the supplied context, citing sources as [n].
Streams tokens to cut perceived latency (time-to-first-token).
Reports token usage for per-tenant cost metering.

failureModes.impact: Requests fail at peak load.
failureModes.mitigation: Retry with backoff, then fail over to a secondary model or region.

failureModes.impact: Users trust an answer the sources do not support.
failureModes.mitigation: Instruct the model to abstain; verify every [n] maps to a real source before display.

failureModes.impact: Answer is cut off mid-sentence.
failureModes.mitigation: Surface the truncation to the UI; offer 'continue'.
